name: sprint34_qhour_open_tail_liquidity_altbasket
hypothesis: qhour_open (quarter-hour VWAP-slicing boundary flow, arXiv 2607.09426) FAILED on majors (sprint09) and liquid-8-alts (sprint16). Momentum/order-flow literature (Liu-Tsyvinski et al., cited sprint18/26) predicts effects concentrate in smaller, less-liquid, higher-turnover names. This basket (same tail-liquidity alts as sprint26/31/32) closes the last untested cell in the 5-signal x 3-universe matrix.
power_argument: C0/C1 calibration: dispersion ~33bp std, T2 cost floor ~26bp -> min detectable edge at n=300,t=2 is ~3.8bp, well below cost floor. 8 symbols x ~92 validation days x cap8/day = up to 5888 possible entries; sprint26 (same basket, different signal) realized 4413 validation trades under identical caps, so n>=300 is near-certain even with BTCSTUSDT/MATICUSDT gaps.
